cases.difference: Counts cover one reconnect burst: Rust allows 18 attempts; TS allows 180000ms after a previously ready role. Both then retain a cancellable five-minute cooldown and retry without user action. Rust test builds scale delay units to milliseconds; TS uses deterministic midpoint jitter and starts the first open immediately.
